required_outcomes: Records that the visit failed for lack of access (no key left, office unreachable), not because the provider failed to attend.
Rebooks the clean with the provider for one of the offered slots, Monday 17 or Tuesday 18 November morning, and confirms it in writing.
Makes the access arrangement explicit for the new visit (keys at the office for collection, or the key safe stocked and its code given), since the flat is empty.
acceptable_alternatives: Asking the provider which of the two mornings suits and stating the key arrangement, if the agent cannot confirm the key in this run.
Telling the landlord briefly that the clean moved to next week because of a key problem on the agency's side.
positive_behaviours: Apologises to the provider for the wasted trip.
Notes that if the provider charges for the wasted visit, that cost sits with the agency and needs agreeing, not the landlord or tenant.
Sets a follow-up after the new date to confirm the clean and get the invoice.
red_flags: Escalating a missed visit that can be rebooked directly.
Recording the visit as a provider no-show.
prohibited_actions: Recording the clean as done or recording an invoice.
Seeking the landlord's approval again for the same £90 job.
critical_failures: Leaving the provider without a new date or key arrangement, so the clean stalls.
